selection_basis: Previously exposed Fig13a in research-resolution-20261006; fixed by handoff before this calculation. Other response workbooks and all NanoBench final files remain unopened.
unit: One selected recording, repeated commands within one discharge; independent pack/run replication unknown.
scope: Descriptive continuous tracking-response replication; no warning training, binary failure labels or causal voltage effect.
threshold_basis: Half the source nominal reference jump, solely to detect commands; not a failure criterion.
metrics: last battery sample strictly before command (V)
calculation: Observed timestamp integration; trapezoidal quadrature of sampled error, squared error and absolute error. Interpolate only the evaluation endpoint if necessary. No resampling, filtering, fits or maximum-thrust inference.
missing: Retain every detected step. Mark windows cut by next command, recording end or nonfinite required values incomplete, with no complete-window metric. Nonincreasing timestamps reject recording. No initial steady interval scored.
comparison: Separate ascending/descending commands; do not count steps as independent runs or claim voltage causation. No invented acceptance threshold.
authorization: Owner existing-session v2 dispatch authorizes the successor question and this public-data software task; physical aircraft, hardware/purchase, maneuver completion and facility remain undecided.
